## EA Media Tools 2.6.5 - jaguar

### Windows UI reliability

- Strengthen the Windows software-rendering fallback by disabling Chromium GPU compositing and the DirectComposition surface path. This prevents the frameless interface from turning blank after encoder changes or advanced-video toggles such as Temporal AQ.
- FFmpeg hardware decoding and encoding remain available because the change applies only to Electron's interface compositor.

### Release targets

- Windows releases are now x64-only. Removing the Windows ARM64 build shortens the release workflow.
- macOS and Debian/Ubuntu releases continue to include x64 and ARM64 packages.

[Review changes since v2.6.4](https://github.com/eaforlife/media-converter/compare/v2.6.4...v2.6.5).
